items.example: We drove through a very long tunnel.
items.mnemonic: Водитель с тунцом едет через тоннель — drive through a tunnel.

items.example: The building is so high that you go into a glass lift.
items.mnemonic: Эльф заходит в лифт — go into a lift.

items.example: His car has to jump across a fifteen-metre gap.
items.mnemonic: Гепард перепрыгивает пропасть — jump over a gap.

items.example: We walked under the bridge when a train went over it.
items.mnemonic: Турист с надписью «андер» идёт под мостом — go under the bridge.

items.example: A man was running towards the exit.
items.mnemonic: Бегун мчится к тауэру — walk towards, идти по направлению к.

items.example: Please move away from the edge of the pool.
We walked across the park on Sunday.
items.mnemonic: Бегуны устроили кросс по парку — walk across.

items.example: The cat fell out of the car window.
items.mnemonic: Судья свистит фол, а кот выпадает — fall out.

items.example: Have you ever taken part in a race?
items.mnemonic: Шахматист с партией участвует — take part in.

items.phrase: what do you think of it?
items.example: I saw Titanic last year. What do you think of it?
items.mnemonic: Танкист спрашивает — what do you think of it, что думаешь.
Журналист с футболом задаёт вопросы — ask follow-up questions.

items.phrase: in her first year as a ...
items.example: Eunice worked on Titanic in her first year as a stuntwoman.
items.mnemonic: Каскадёрша с фаршем вспоминает первый год — in her first year.
